description: Elemental caster DPS - earth and fire spells channeled through Geode Barrage and Earthquake.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 10 confirmed Geomancy nodes expanded to a 12-node tree (2 class-wide-flavored additions, matching the Storm Ascendance/Vizier precedent) since this was the smallest of the 4 real spec lists. Earthshaping confirmed as capstone: 'Casting Geode Barrage and your Seismic abilities now generate Earthshaping. Empowers some of your abilities and increases your spell haste by 1% for 20 seconds, stacking 15 times.'

nodes.name: Magmatism
nodes.description: Increases Spell Power by 5 per rank.

nodes.name: Therazane's Might
nodes.description: Increases Geode Barrage damage by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: One With The Earth
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Cave Dweller
nodes.description: Learn Golem Form, a shapeshift into an earthen golem that increases Armor and reduces spell cast time.
nodes._source: CoA tags this 'Specialization' - a form-flavored capstone-tier ability, but unlike Venomancer's forms it doesn't change resource type (still Mana+Rage), so implemented as a strong self-buff via is_instant rather than the full forms.py shapeshift system.

nodes.name: Earthshaping

nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed verbatim, kept as the Geomancy capstone.

nodes.name: Quake
nodes.description: Learn Quake, stomping the ground to damage and slow nearby enemies.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Geomancy-locked (not Mountain King as an earlier pass guessed from the name), Lvl 20 (Rank 1 shown), 2 Charges, 8 sec recharge, 'Stomp the ground, dealing Weapon Damage plus 28 Nature damage to enemies within 8 yds and reducing their melee and ranged haste by 20% for 10 sec.'

nodes.name: Seismic Tremor
nodes.description: Learn Seismic Tremor, sending an escalating tremor through the earth at an enemy. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Geomancy-locked, Lvl 26, '157 Physical damage, plus an additional 1080 over 24 sec. Damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up over time. Damage dealt generates 1 Rage.'
